name: Forno Acqua Elite White Luxurious Super Smart Toilet
shortDescription: FORNO ACQUA Super Smart Toilet – The Ultimate Bathroom Upgrade. Transform your bathroom with the FORNO ACQUA Super Smart Toilet. This advanced tankless bidet toilet is designed for modern homes, offering full customization for a truly personalized cleansing experience. Adjustable bidet wand extension, water temperature and pressure settings. Auto-sensing lid, seat, and flush plus Foot sensor for total touchless operation. Certified to MaP’s highest performance standards, the Auto Dual Flush system delivers powerful, clog-free performance. Built-in heated seat for year-round comfort. Integrated deodorizer for a fresher bathroom environment. Combining comfort, hygiene, and smart technology, the FORNO ACQUA Smart Toilet is the perfect upgrade for any bathroom. Whether you're remodeling or building new, this intelligent toilet delivers a cleaner, more elegant lifestyle. Experience the future of bathroom innovation with your FORNO ACQUA Super Smart Toilet.

features.text: Elite Smart Bidet Toilet Heated Seat
Built-In Bidet – Adjustable spray strength, water temperature, nozzle position and massage functions (pulsate & oscillate) for personalized hygiene & comfort
High-Performance Flush – AcquaPOWER technology delivers best-in-class 1000g MaP performance for a quiet, powerful, clog-free waste removal
Heated Seat – Enjoy soothing warmth with 4 adjustable temperature settings for personalized comfort year-round
Touchless Walk-Away Flush – AcquaSMART triggers a smart dual flush when you step away or tap the foot sensor. Hands-free, hygienic, and effortless
AcquaSMART Advanced Technology - automatic lid open & close, foot sensor seat open & close and lid close for seamless, hands-free convenience
Smart Dual Flush – Automatically adjusts flush volume based on usage to maximize water efficiency
